title: Quick Crispy Tunisian Sweet Rice Flour Chapssalgaru Sushi
description: A funky and indulgent Tunisian dish featuring sweet rice flour chapssalgaru, shaped into nigiri style sushi, perfect for those who prefer no onion and no garlic, served on a vibrant talavera plate.
instructions: In a large mixing bowl, combine the sweet rice flour, sugar, salt, and Tunisian spice blend, stirring until well combined.
Gradually add in the water, stirring with a wooden spoon until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into small balls, about the size of a small egg.
Roll out each ball into a thin circle, about 1/8 inch thick.
Heat the vegetable oil in a large frying pan over medium heat, until it reaches 350 degrees Fahrenheit.
Fry the sweet rice flour circles until crispy and golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
Drain the fried circles on paper towels and let cool for a minute or two.
Shape the cooled circles into nigiri style sushi, filling with chapssalgaru and garnishing with sesame seeds.
Serve immediately on a talavera plate and enjoy.
